data.notes: As of the latest available listings, Ibiza’s September 2027 superclub residencies and closing-party calendars are not yet broadly announced; only independently ticketed weekender-style events have solid public confirmation.

events.title: Our House Ibiza 2027
events.summary: A five-day Ibiza party package led by Rob Tissera and Dale Castell, promising boat parties, super-club events, intimate venue events, pool parties and bar takeovers, with listed styles including house, funky house, trance, old skool and club classics.

events.title: Terrace Soul / Ibiza Soul Weekender 2027
events.venueName: San Antonio Bay beachfront hotel (to be announced)
events.summary: A three-day soul-focused Ibiza weekender from Terrace Soul, with daytime pool DJ sessions, sunset sessions and a closing boat party. Confirmed phase-one DJs include Paul Alexander, Jez, Carl Bassett and Errol.

events.title: Secret Underground Ibiza 2027
events.summary: A Dutch-led underground/fetish club night at Liberty Club Ibiza, running 23:00–04:00 with a confirmed DJ lineup including Mr & Mrs Secret, Iwan, Eric van Kleef and Emiel Roché across house, tech-house and techno-adjacent sounds.
